snapshot.text: Public health and social services have been run since 2023 by wellbeing services counties instead of municipalities. An interim evaluation finds the reform progressing but in need of corrections to meet its goals, including cost control.

minister.name: Wille Rydman
minister.role: Minister of Social Affairs and Health

priorities.title: Fixing the wellbeing county reform
priorities.text: Ministers steering the wellbeing services counties say fixing the reform's flaws requires persistence.
